name: Scam a Brainrot
desc:
🚔  Don't Let them to Catch you

Sneak around the police and scam the Brainrots! 👮 
Equip Them and place them on your plot to earn Money! 💰 
Collect as much brainrots as you can and reach the cash leaderboards! 🏆 

 If you like the game, don't forget to hit the like button 👍
